name: review-fix
description: Review a part of the code, then fix what the review found

steps.title: Review it
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

List each real problem with its file and line: bugs, missing tests, risky code. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Fix what it found
steps.prompt:
Fix every problem the review below found in: {target}

If it found none, stop. Run the tests before you stop.
